def R2PairLine (start : SurfPos) (own outer : Nat) (e : SurfPos) : Prop :=
  ∀ i c : SurfPos, SIndent own e i → GLit ':' i c →
    ∀ v : SurfPos, SBlockIndented own .blockOut c v →
      ExplValueLine start outer v

def R2PairSeed (sc : ScannerState) (start keyStart : SurfPos) : Prop :=
  ∃ own : Nat, ∀ outer ∈ RegisterWitness.markedCols sc, outer ≠ own →
    ∀ e : SurfPos, SBlockIndented own .blockOut keyStart e →
      R2PairLine start own outer e

def R2PairSeq (sc : ScannerState) (start entry : SurfPos) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ own : Nat, ∀ outer ∈ RegisterWitness.markedCols sc, outer ≠ own →
    ∀ m : SurfPos, SBlockIndented n .blockIn entry m →
    ∀ e : SurfPos, SCompactSeqTail n m e →
      R2PairLine start own outer e

def R2PairContent (sc : ScannerState) (start gram : SurfPos) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ own : Nat, ∀ outer ∈ RegisterWitness.markedCols sc, outer ≠ own →
    ∀ m : SurfPos, SSLComments gram m →
    ∀ e : SurfPos, SCompactSeqTail n m e →
      R2PairLine start own outer e

def R2PairValue (sc : ScannerState) (start colon : SurfPos) (own : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ outer ∈ RegisterWitness.markedCols sc, outer ≠ own →
    ∀ m : SurfPos, SBlockIndented own .blockOut colon m →
      ExplValueLine start outer m
